title: Unpeel App Kit UI protocol v1
description: Durable component projections between terminal Apps and Host-brokered native, web, or agent participants. Attachments use Host-minted route-bound participant tokens. Implementations ignore unknown fields inside recognized message and value kinds. An unsupported component kind causes pane-level terminal fallback without rejecting the attachment.

footerAction.description: One App-owned screen action with an optional single physical-key accelerator.

footerActions.description: Ordered screen-level action slot shared by Page, Tree, and MarkdownEditor roots.

semanticMenu.description: Bounded action menu; anchor is resolved in each renderer's local coordinate space.

surfaceReference.description: Opaque route resolved and authorized by the existing Host; never a socket, URL, credential, or USRF header.

surface.description: Reference-only canvas embed. Retained scenes/resources use the separate USRF stream and every presenter renders locally.

canvasSurface.description: Named, closed Surface slot; scene/resource bytes remain on USRF.

unsupportedCanvasControl.description: Opaque future Canvas control retained only to trigger whole-pane terminal fallback.

canvasPage.description: One Surface slot plus a bounded fixed top overlay of semantic controls.

disclosure.description: Navigation affordance only; the ListItem activate action remains the App-owned router.

listItemTextRun.description: One closed semantic text span. Omitted tone/emphasis inherit the containing ListItem field.

sparkline.description: Read-only numeric history. Inferred bounds include zero; all-zero domains resolve to 0...1 in every renderer.

barChart.description: Minimal categorical chart with labeled non-negative numeric bars.

lineChart.description: Minimal multi-series x/y line chart with optional axis bounds and labels.

gauge.description: Minimal labeled ratio from zero through one with optional App-authored value caption; valid as a Page body or one trailing ListItem slot. A ListItem value, when present, is the visible rich caption while Gauge contributes the compact meter.

unsupportedRowSlot.description: Opaque future row control retained so a renderer can fall back to the terminal pane.

content.description: Read-only scrollable styled document content; not an editor.

treePrimaryAction.description: The one constrained toolbar action accepted by Tree; no arbitrary children.

tree.description: Closed file/document hierarchy. Item ids are opaque App keys, never Host filesystem paths.

unsupportedComponent.description: Opaque future root retained only so a renderer can keep its attachment and expose the terminal pane.
